prompts.name: answer-from-course-files
prompts.description: Use when the user asks what a course's material says (syllabus rules, lecture notes, assignment handouts) and the answer should come from their uploaded files, with citations.

prompts.name: answer-schedule-questions
prompts.description: Use when the user asks when something happens: their next class, what is on a day or week, what is due soon, exam dates, or when a course meets.

prompts.name: edit-class-schedule
prompts.description: Use when the user wants to add, change, cancel, move or hide classes, change a room, keep only their own tutorial, or add, change or delete one-off events such as exams and office hours.

prompts.name: grade-planning
prompts.description: Use when the user asks what they need on the rest of a course ("what do I need on the final to get an A", "final grade needed"), or asks a what-if about scores or GPA.

prompts.name: import-from-documents
prompts.description: Use when the user shares a syllabus, timetable, ICS file or screenshot and wants its courses, grading scheme, class times or dates in the app ("import this", "import syllabus", "set up my courses from these"), or to finish an import an LMS tool started.

prompts.name: manage-tasks
prompts.description: Use when the user wants to add a to-do or reminder ("remind me to…"), or find, finish, change, move or delete tasks and task lists, or asks about the task list itself (flagged, overdue, unsorted).

prompts.name: manage-terms-and-courses
prompts.description: Use when the user wants to add, rename, re-date or delete a semester or course, set reading weeks and holidays, or make a course year-long.

prompts.name: record-grades
prompts.description: Use when the user reports a score they got ("I got 82 on the midterm", "Lab 3: 18/20") or an official final grade, to record it on the right assessment or course.

prompts.name: setup-gradebook
prompts.description: Use when the user tells you a course's grading scheme in the chat ("2 midterms 25% each, final 40%") and wants the gradebook built from it. A scheme in a file or syllabus is imported instead.

prompts.name: use-lms
prompts.description: Use when the user asks about their LMS (Canvas) courses, such as announcements, assignments, feedback, pages, modules, files, quizzes or grades there, or wants to link a course or bring LMS assignments or a syllabus into the app.
